verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Metrics Explorer for analyzing product data and a general statement about monitoring service health. Nothing in the pack describes subscribing to dashboards or alerting when a metric moves abnormally. Dashboards and alerting are a fair axis for an analytics platform, so this is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can subscribe to dashboards and get alerted when a key metric moves abnormally
